a:r.a:t: (based on conversations with Tricia Deane, Graham O’Dell, Barry Hillicks, and John Piechoczek)

Our recent discussions have resulted in an adjustment to our original approach. While Intact has made progress addressing traditional technical debt through infrastructure decommissioning and the Personal Lines exit, stakeholders highlighted that the opportunities also lie elsewhere.
focus has therefore broadened from a narrow focus on technical debt to a broader look at liability, across the following dimensions:
complex dependencies, integrations and platform coupling
manual workarounds, inefficient handoffs and SME dependency
missing or incomplete documentation, inconsistent standards and templates, low discoverability
quality issues, data lineage and traceability challenges

Stakeholders identified Specialty Lines (SL) as the ideal environment to validate this approach. The proposed PoV will focus on making these liabilities visible, quantifying their business impact, and identifying targeted interventions to reduce complexity, improve agility and accelerate future transformation. In doing so, the assessment will also help uncover residual pockets of technical debt that remain across these five dimensions.
